d: Bangal ki khari men uthe ganbhir chakravati tuphan 'akvan' ke prabhav se bihar men agle tin dinon tak mausam men badlav ki sanbhavna jataee gaee hai. patna sthit mausam vigyan kendr ne 20 se 22 navanbar ke bich rajy ke kaee jilon men barish ka purvanuman jari kiya hai. mausam vibhag ke anusar, chakravati tuphan 'akvan' bangal ki khari se 26 kilomitar prati ghante ki raphtar se aage barh raha hai.
